Flip signs of MB-sPLS weights/loadings/scores

Source: R/mbspls_flip_weights.R
mbspls_flip_weights.Rd

The reported MB-sPLS criteria depend only on absolute (or squared) cross-block correlations, so they do not identify the sign of a block's weights. Flipping a block's weights together with its loadings and scores therefore leaves the fit, the objective and explained variances unchanged, and can be used to orient components for reporting. Per-block sign matrices keep the fit unchanged only for such sign-invariant criteria.

All sign-dependent fields that are present are flipped consistently: weights, loadings, the stability-selection outputs weights_stable, loadings_stable, weights_stable_ci, loadings_stable_ci, weights_stable_frequency and loadings_stable_frequency, the bootstrap summary weights_ci (means and interval bounds, which are swapped), selection (training and stable weights), user-supplied weights_boot_draws and the score columns LV<k>_<block> of T_mat, T_mat_train, T_mat_train_stable_all, T_mat_train_stable_kept and T_mat_train_kept. Names and dimensions are preserved. Selection frequencies are sign-free and stay unchanged.

  • The list method flips an MB-sPLS state (as stored by po("mbspls")) and returns it.

  • The PipeOpMBsPLS method flips the trained state and the matching run entry of its log_env (read by bootstrap selection and by predict_weights), so later predictions are negated consistently. The stored prediction payload of that run (log_env$mbspls_last[[run_id]], and log_env$last if it belongs to the run) has its scores T_mat flipped as well; its sign-free statistics are unchanged. The state of a separately trained PipeOpMBsPLSBootstrapSelect is not changed; flip a GraphLearner to keep both in sync.

  • The GraphLearner method flips the fitted MB-sPLS state, the state of every PipeOpMBsPLSBootstrapSelect node of the same run and the log_env run entry with its prediction payload. It works in place only when every node downstream of the MB-sPLS node is sign-transparent (a bootstrap-select node, po("nop") or a featureless learner): other downstream models were trained on the original LV columns and would silently change their predictions, so an error is raised. With inplace = FALSE the learner and its log_env are left unchanged and a flipped copy of x$model is returned, e.g. for plotting.

mbspls_flip_weights(x, signs = -1L, ...)

# S3 method for class 'list'
mbspls_flip_weights(x, signs = -1L, flip_boot = TRUE, flip_T = TRUE, ...)

# S3 method for class 'PipeOpMBsPLS'
mbspls_flip_weights(
  x,
  signs = -1L,
  inplace = TRUE,
  flip_boot = TRUE,
  flip_T = TRUE,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'GraphLearner'
mbspls_flip_weights(
  x,
  signs = -1L,
  inplace = TRUE,
  flip_boot = TRUE,
  flip_T = TRUE,
  mbspls_id = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

Object containing MB-sPLS state/model

signs

Controls what to flip. One of:

  • scalar +1/-1 (applied to ALL components & blocks; -1 means "flip all"),

  • numeric vector length K (per component; replicated across blocks),

  • numeric matrix K x B with rownames = components (e.g., "LC_01") and colnames = block names; entries must be +1/-1 (NA keeps the sign).

...

Additional arguments passed to methods

flip_boot

Also flip stability-selection and bootstrap outputs if present (default TRUE)

flip_T

Also flip score matrix columns (default TRUE)

inplace

Modify object in-place (TRUE) or return flipped state (FALSE)

mbspls_id

Optional id of the MB-sPLS node when the graph has several.

Value

The flipped state for the list method; for the other methods the modified object (invisibly) when inplace = TRUE, otherwise the flipped state (PipeOpMBsPLS) or model list (GraphLearner).
